blocks.text: Why Slack is the command center for e-commerce

As an e-commerce merchandiser, you live in a world of constant context switching. You jump from Shopify dashboards to inventory management tools like Cin7 Core, then back to Slack to discuss a supplier delay. Slack acts as the glue for these disparate systems. It connects your marketing team with your logistics partners and customer support staff. When you are on a Mac, you have a distinct advantage. The desktop app provides deep integration with macOS features. It allows for quick navigation and fast communication.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Speed is your best friend when managing hundreds of products. Stop clicking through menus and start using your keyboard. Pressing Command + / opens the full list of shortcuts inside the app. Use Command + K to open the Quick Switcher, which lets you jump to any channel or contact by typing a few letters. If you need to find a specific message, Command + F searches the current channel, while Command + G performs a global search. These shortcuts save seconds every time you use them. Over a day, those seconds turn into minutes of saved time.

items: Command + K: Jump to any conversation
Command + F: Search within your current channel
Command + G: Search across your entire workspace
Shift + Enter: Create a new line without sending your message

blocks.text: Manage channel sprawl on your Mac

E-commerce teams often create dozens of channels for specific projects, product launches, or seasonal sales. This results in channel sprawl, where you lose track of important conversations. Start by archiving channels that are no longer active. If a channel is noisy but necessary, right-click it in the sidebar and select Mute. This keeps the channel in your list but stops it from sending you notifications for every minor update. You can also use [the threads view](/how-to/open-the-threads-view-in-slack) to keep related discussions together rather than cluttering the main channel feed.

Lazur helps you stay in your flow on your Mac. You do not need to switch apps or hunt for a specific window when you have a quick task. Hold the Option + Command keys to ask Lazur about anything on your screen. If you are stuck in a complex Slack thread, ask Lazur to summarize the recent messages. If you need to find a link you saw earlier, ask Lazur to search for it. You can even use Lazur to dictate responses when you are away from your keyboard or need to type quickly.

Slack can sometimes feel sluggish on older Macs or when you have many workspaces open. If you notice lag while typing or switching channels, the most effective fix is to clear your cache. Go to the menu bar and select Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This forces the app to reload your data from the server. It often resolves issues with images not loading or messages failing to send. Always ensure you are running the latest version of the app. Check for updates by clicking Slack in the menu bar and selecting Check for Updates.

Your time is better spent on merchandising strategy than on managing notifications. Set up a schedule for your Slack notifications to ensure you have periods of deep work. Go to your profile menu and select Preferences > Notifications to set your active hours. If you are working on a major product launch, use the [pause notifications](/how-to/pause-notifications-in-slack) feature to silence alerts for a set time. This simple step prevents interruptions during critical data analysis tasks.

faq.question: How do I find the latest Slack version on Mac?
faq.answer: Click Slack in the menu bar and select About Slack to see your current version. You can download the latest version directly from the official Slack website.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me write messages in Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into the Slack input field. Lazur will format your speech into clean, readable text.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is running slow?
faq.answer: Try clearing your cache by going to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is the most common fix for performance issues.

faq.question: Is there a way to see all my shortcuts?
faq.answer: Yes, press Command + / while the Slack window is active to open the full list of keyboard shortcuts.
